# MediaFlow Studio 1.3.2 — Animated stickers from your images, and a sidebar that follows your workflow

## ✨ New

### 🎞️ GIF & Stickers now animates still images
- Drop a **PNG, JPEG or WebP** next to your videos: MediaFlow brings it to life as a looping **GIF** or **animated WebP** — perfect for Discord, Telegram or WhatsApp stickers.
- Pick the motion:
  - **Bounce**, **Float**, **Pulse**
  - **Sway**, **Shake**, **Spin**
  - **Sparkle**, with twinkling points of light
- Choose how long one loop lasts (1 to 6 seconds). Every motion loops seamlessly, with no jump at the end.
- Transparent images stay **transparent**, in GIF as in WebP.
- New **320p · sticker** size, next to 240p to 720p.
- The frame rate (10 to 30 fps), the loop option and the clean colour palette (no grain, no banding) work the same as for videos.
- Each file only shows the settings it uses: start and length for videos, motion and loop length for images.

## 💡 Improved

### 🧭 A sidebar in workflow order
- The tools are now grouped the way a project goes:

| Step | Tools |
| :-- | :-- |
| **Capture** | Downloader |
| **Preparation** | Converter |
| **Editing** | Trimmer · Auto-Cut · Audio Extractor |
| **Enhancement** | AI Enhance |
| **Export & sharing** | Compressor · GIF & Stickers |
| **Diagnostics** | Inspector |

- The group names are translated into the 9 languages.
- The window opens a little taller, so the whole list fits without scrolling.
- The README screenshots show the new layout.

Already on 1.2.x or 1.3.x? The app offers this update automatically: click **Update**, then **Restart & Install**.
